arguments.command:
cat > /workspace/project/README.md <<'PYEOF'
# H3Act offline evidence pipeline

Run `python3 -B main.py` with a single JSON document on stdin. Pydantic and its
pinned dependencies are preinstalled; no network, model, certificate or service
configuration is needed. Read `../PROTOCOL.md` and `../RUNTIME.md` for the contract.

## Layout

| File | Role |
| --- | --- |
| `main.py` | strict document validation, template compilation, orchestration |
| `schema.py` | typed payload models (`H3HeaderFrame`, `H3DataFrame`, `H3SleepFrame`, `FuzzingPayload`) |
| `modules/byte_program.py` | compressed byte sequences (rope), expression compiler, template compiler |
| `modules/fuzz_adapter.py` | frame conversion, offline transport, receipt encoding |
| `HTTP3_Just_Send.py` | `HttpClient` request lifecycle over the injected transport |
| `modules/clock.py` | socket-free coroutine clock for the event tape |
| `modules/events.py` | decoded event records (`HeadersReceived`, `DataReceived`, `ConnectionTerminated`) |
| `modules/capture_audit.py` | HTTP/1.1 origin framing, provenance and paired evidence flags |

## How it fits together

`main.py` validates the whole document before anything is executed: duplicate
keys, wrong types, unknown members, lone surrogates and every published budget
are rejected with `{"error":"input"}`. Frame and event templates are compiled
by `modules/byte_program.py`, which keeps byte sequences as a shared rope so
that very large captures and repeated boundary probes are never expanded. The
typed models feed `FuzzExecutor`, whose frame conversion and `HttpClient` feed
an injected decoded-event backend driven by the offline clock. The client
replay produces exact receipts (`time`, `stream`, `kind`, content, end marker)
and lifecycle outcomes (`ok`, `timeout`, `closed`, `send_error`).

`modules/capture_audit.py` then reads every channel as one HTTP/1.1 byte
stream, publishes the fully framed requests with their body, trailer and field
block fingerprints, attributes request bytes to the capture parts that supplied
them and derives the request and case level evidence flags.

You may edit/reorganize this complete directory and add source/data files within
the published tree budget. No particular internal algorithm or call graph is
required. Functional output must satisfy the complete protocol. A public checker
PASS is only a small sanity result.
PYEOF
